basic_profile.bio: I'm a 23-year-old gamer from Stockholm, Sweden, who recently got into Reddit to connect with other players of Ragnarok Mobile. I’m also a casual player of other games, such as Royale High. I work part-time as a barista and spend my evenings gaming or browsing Reddit. I'm single and usually online during late evenings or early mornings due to my work schedule.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a decent understanding of mobile games like Ragnarok Mobile, gained mostly through trial and error and following gaming forums. I occasionally follow the Allsvenskan league, catching matches online when I can.
